failure_modes.mode: Draft preview differs from executed configuration
failure_modes.cause: Editor changes ignored until saved or separate merge logic
failure_modes.detection: Draft/config/launch parity and stale preview-token tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Shared effective run config and preview fingerprint; exact-plan review; capture the same normalized config

failure_modes.mode: Total cap exceeded across sources or workers
failure_modes.cause: Per-source limits only or concurrent inserts
failure_modes.mitigation: Shared context-local budget, serialized storage batches and count only real new inserts; stop further source work at cap

failure_modes.cause: Provider keyword search not an exact title filter
failure_modes.detection: Representative adviser/coordinator versus support/data title fixtures
failure_modes.mitigation: Explicit matching-title filter before storage and Workday details; preview explains matching rules

failure_modes.detection: Run membership queue and scoring-repair/invalidation tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Default new-run membership using reserved cc_campaign_jobs namespace; explicit bounded matching-saved mode

failure_modes.mode: Zero selections or zero budgets interpreted as all
failure_modes.detection: Empty source/role and positive-budget validation tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Explicit bounded dashboard run policy; reject empty/unbounded scoped plans; retain old CLI path separately

failure_modes.mode: Cancellation or deployment replays live work
failure_modes.cause: Automatic retry or inherited active worker
failure_modes.mitigation: No automatic restart; only user-confirmed plans launch, no live searches in verification
